text: Duration 1 to 3 years Awarded Nanchang University Certificate, HSK certificate (if qualified) Main Coures Chinese listening, speaking, reading and writing. There are 3 levels: easy, medium and high level courses. All of which aim at improving students' Chinese language abilities. Advantages of This Course 1. The only HSK test center in Jiangxi Province. 2. One on one student partnership. 3. Focus on daily Chinese usage and modern Chinese.
